description: Fallout 76-inspired mutation system for Atomic Fizz Caps. Mutations are permanent (or semi-permanent) stat changes caused by radiation exposure or serum injection. Each mutation has a benefit AND a drawback — there are no pure upgrades. Serums apply a specific mutation reliably; raw radiation exposure applies a random one.
mechanic_note: Mutations stack up to 5 active at once. Removing a mutation requires a Mutation Suppressant serum or visiting a decontamination shower at a settlement. Some mutations conflict with each other. The Starched Genes perk (from leveling) makes mutations permanent and prevents new ones from overwriting.

mutations.name: Adrenal Reaction
mutations.description: Your adrenal glands have mutated to produce a combat-grade hormonal surge when you're injured.
mutations.benefit: +damage scales with missing HP — up to +50% damage at 20% HP. Adrenaline rush on kill: +10% speed for 5 seconds.
mutations.drawback: -50 max HP. You burn out fast.

mutations.name: Bird Bones
mutations.description: Your skeletal density has reduced dramatically, redistributing mass.
mutations.benefit: +4 Agility. Falling damage reduced 50%. Movement silent (+15% stealth).
mutations.drawback: -4 Strength. Carrying capacity -30 lbs.

mutations.name: Carnivore
mutations.description: Your digestive system has mutated to extract nutrients only from meat. Vegetables are actively harmful.
mutations.benefit: Meat restores double HP and AP. Cooked meat grants a 10% damage bonus for 30 minutes. Never hungry while eating meat.
mutations.drawback: Plant-based food causes nausea (-2 Agility for 10 min). Vegetable items have zero nutritional value.

mutations.name: Chameleon
mutations.description: Your skin can shift pigmentation to match your surroundings when you're still.
mutations.benefit: While standing still and unencumbered: full invisibility. Enemies cannot target you. Sneak attacks deal +50% damage.
mutations.drawback: Effect cancels immediately on movement. Wearing armor reduces duration by 50%.

mutations.name: Electrically Charged
mutations.description: Your body generates static charge from movement.
mutations.benefit: 10% chance to shock attackers on melee hit (15 damage). +20% energy weapon damage.
mutations.drawback: 5% chance to shock yourself when using energy weapons (-10 HP). Chance increases in rain.

mutations.name: Empath
mutations.description: Your nervous system has developed hyperreactive mirror neurons.
mutations.benefit: Companions take 25% less damage while you're with them. +5% experience from companion interactions.
mutations.drawback: You take 33% of any damage your companion receives. Companion pain reduces your accuracy.

mutations.name: Eagle Eyes
mutations.description: Your visual cortex and eye structure have mutated for extreme long-range sight.
mutations.benefit: +4 Perception. +25% critical hit damage. Ranged weapons have +30% effective range.
mutations.drawback: -4 Strength. Close-range targets harder to track (-15% accuracy within 10m).

mutations.name: Grounded
mutations.description: Your body has become hyperconductive to earth charge, dissipating electrical buildup.
mutations.benefit: +100 energy resistance. Immune to paralysis. Electric attacks deal 50% less damage to you.
mutations.drawback: -50% energy weapon damage output. Lightning strikes target you in storms.

mutations.name: Herbivore
mutations.description: Your digestive chemistry has inverted — plant fiber is now the only thing your gut can process.
mutations.benefit: Plant foods restore double HP and AP. Cooked plants grant +2 Intelligence for 30 minutes.
mutations.drawback: Meat and protein causes illness (-2 Strength for 10 min). Protein items have zero nutritional value.

mutations.name: Herd Mentality
mutations.description: Your social brain has rewired to draw strength from proximity to others.
mutations.benefit: +2 to all SPECIAL stats while grouped with companions or other players in the same zone.
mutations.drawback: -2 to all SPECIAL stats when alone. Solo play becomes systematically harder.

mutations.name: Marsupial
mutations.description: You've developed a secondary abdominal pouch and dramatically enhanced leg musculature.
mutations.benefit: +20 carrying capacity. Jump height doubled. Fall damage reduced by 25%.
mutations.drawback: -4 Intelligence. Problem-solving instincts replaced with bounce instincts.

mutations.name: Plague Walker
mutations.description: Your body hosts a concentrated ecosystem of beneficial mutant bacteria.
mutations.benefit: Poison damage scales with disease count — more diseases you carry, more toxic your attacks. Immune to disease effects (you're the disease now).
mutations.drawback: Companions take periodic disease damage from proximity (1 disease stack per 4 hours). Settlers won't trade with you.

mutations.name: Scaly Skin
mutations.description: Your dermis has keratinized into overlapping protective scales.
mutations.benefit: +50 damage resistance. +25 radiation resistance. Shrug off small arms fire.
mutations.drawback: -1 Agility. Worn armor provides 15% less protection (doesn't fit over scales).

mutations.name: Speed Demon
mutations.description: Your metabolism has gone into overdrive.
mutations.benefit: +20% movement speed. Reload speed +30%. Actions cost 10% less AP.
mutations.drawback: Hunger and thirst deplete 50% faster. Food items restore 25% less. Stimulants have 50% reduced duration.

mutations.name: Talons
mutations.description: Your fingernails have grown into dense keratin claws capable of tearing through light armor.
mutations.benefit: Unarmed attacks deal +25 damage. Claws ignore 20% of enemy armor.
mutations.drawback: Fine manipulation is harder: lockpicking difficulty +1 tier. Reloading weapons takes 15% longer.

mutations.name: Twisted Muscles
mutations.description: Your muscle fiber has mutated into denser, more powerful configurations — grotesquely so.
mutations.benefit: +4 Strength. Melee damage +25%. Chance to cripple enemy limbs on melee hits (15%).
mutations.drawback: -4 Agility. Guns have 50% worse accuracy (your hands shake constantly).

mutations.name: Unstable Isotope
mutations.description: Your cells have become mildly radioactive. You glow faintly in the dark.
mutations.benefit: Melee attackers take 10 radiation damage on hit. Radaway restores +50 HP alongside rads. Ghouls won't attack you unprovoked.
mutations.drawback: Stealth is nearly impossible (you glow). Radiation weapons deal 25% more damage to you. Decontamination zones hurt.

mutations.name: Healing Factor
mutations.description: Your cellular regeneration rate has increased dramatically.
mutations.benefit: Regenerate 2 HP per minute passively. Stimpaks act faster (2 second use time). Resting heals +50% more HP.
mutations.drawback: Chems and stimpaks are 55% less effective (your body metabolizes them too fast). Radiation resistance -25.

mutations.name: Glass Cannon
mutations.description: Your attack cells have become hyperactive at the cost of everything protective.
mutations.benefit: +30% all damage output. Critical hit chance +15%.
mutations.drawback: -50% all damage resistance. You hit hard. You also go down hard.

mutations.name: Rad Sponge
mutations.description: Your immune system treats radiation as a nutrient.
mutations.benefit: Radiation exposure restores HP (1 HP per 5 rads absorbed). Immune to radiation sickness effects. Rad-contaminated food is safe to eat.
mutations.drawback: Radiation no longer reduces max HP but does accumulate — at 1000 rads your mutation destabilizes and you gain a random second mutation.

serums.name: Adrenal Reaction Serum
serums.description: A concentrated hormonal activator in a pre-war needle. Guaranteed adrenal mutation on injection.

serums.name: Bird Bones Serum
serums.description: Skeletal density reducer. Side effects: hollow feeling, tendency to look at heights.

serums.name: Carnivore Serum
serums.description: Digestive enzyme replacement. Best injected before a meal rather than after.

serums.name: Chameleon Serum
serums.description: Extremely rare pigmentation activator. The syringe changes color as you hold it. That's not a good sign.

serums.name: Electrically Charged Serum
serums.description: Static charge activator. Comes with complementary rubber gloves that will definitely not help.

serums.name: Empath Serum
serums.description: Neural sensitizer. Users report feeling everything more intensely. Everything. Including their companion's stubbed toe.

serums.name: Eagle Eyes Serum
serums.description: Ocular enhancement serum. May cause temporary double vision, then permanent single vision across very long distances.

serums.name: Grounded Serum
serums.description: Earth-charge conductor. Safe to inject during a thunderstorm. Not recommended.

serums.name: Herbivore Serum
serums.description: Enzymatic inverter. Comes with a small packet of mixed greens from the old world. They're still technically food.

serums.name: Herd Mentality Serum
serums.description: Social amplifier. Best results when injected in company. Worse results when you're alone at 3am wondering what the point is.

serums.name: Marsupial Serum
serums.description: Structural redistribution compound. Warning: urge to carry everything in a pouch is a known side effect.

serums.name: Plague Walker Serum
serums.description: Bacterial colonization agent. Do not inject near friends. Actually, don't inject near anyone.

serums.name: Scaly Skin Serum
serums.description: Dermal hardener. The scales start small. They get less small over several days.

serums.name: Speed Demon Serum
serums.description: Metabolic accelerator. Do not inject and then try to have a slow breakfast. You won't manage it.

serums.name: Talons Serum
serums.description: Keratin stimulator. Typing this label was the last easy thing the writer did.

serums.name: Twisted Muscles Serum
serums.description: Fiber-density maximizer. Expect to hear uncomfortable sounds for 24 hours post-injection.

serums.name: Unstable Isotope Serum
serums.description: Radioactive cell activator. Comes in a lead-lined container for a reason.

serums.name: Healing Factor Serum
serums.description: Cellular regeneration activator. Rare, effective, and slightly unnerving to watch work.

serums.name: Glass Cannon Serum
serums.description: Offensive amplifier. Maximum aggression. Minimum self-preservation. Some might call this unwise.

serums.name: Rad Sponge Serum
serums.description: Radiation processing activator. The syringe itself is mildly radioactive. This tracks.

serums.name: Mutation Suppressant
serums.description: Removes one mutation at random from your active stack. Developed by Vault-Tec. Counterintuitively, this was the ethical part of the program.

radiation_exposure_rules.note: When player's radiation exceeds threshold and rolls successfully, a random mutation from the list is applied. If mutation conflicts with an active one, it is rerolled once.
